forecast-period.text: A trough of low pressure and cold front about the west, will move over the remainder of South Australia today. Another cold front clips the southeast on Monday, followed by a high pressure system, which will then move across southern parts of the state on Tuesday. A trough of low pressure approaches the western border on Wednesday whilst a cold font moves over waters to the south.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Showers and isolated thunderstorms about the agricultural areas and adjacent parts to the north, contracting to the northeast later. Isolated showers redevelop about the southern coasts late. Maximum temperatures well above average in the east, tending to below average in the far west. Fresh and gusty north to northwesterly winds in the east ahead of a fresh and gusty west to southwesterly change extending throughout during the day.

Isolated showers about the southern agricultural area, clearing by the evening. Showers and thunderstorms about the northeast, contracting to the far northeast. Maximum temperatures below average, tending to above average in the far northeast. West to southwesterly winds about coastal areas, fresh at times. Winds tending south to southeasterly winds elsewhere, freshening at times further north.
Afternoon showers and thunderstorms about the far north. Maximum temperatures below average. Southwest to southeasterly winds, tending easterly in the west.

text.p: Showers and thunderstorms developing about the far west later. Maximum temperatures average to above average. South to southeasterly winds tending northeasterly in the west.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Wednesday: 1 to 5 mm about the agricultural areas, northeast and far west with local falls of 5 to 10 mm possible about southern coasts and the far northeast. Localised falls between 10 to 20 mm are possible with thunderstorms about the far northeast and far west.
